fact: UNHCR Senegal states that on lodging an asylum application with the Commission Nationale d'Eligibilite in Dakar, the applicant receives a recepisse valid six months and renewable, which lets them move freely in Senegal pending the decision.
system: Commission Nationale d'Eligibilite (CNE) asylum application and recepisse

fact: Senegal decree 2025-1560 of 17 September 2025 sets out the introduction of a biometric ID card and travel document for recognised refugees and stateless people, issued by the Interior Ministry with the CNGRA coordinating.
system: biometric refugee identity card and travel document

fact: Decree 2025-1559 provides that asylum applications may be filed electronically, receive a receipt and are recorded in the refugee and stateless database, with a refugee identity card issued on admission.
